---
title: "Ten-week study route"
---

This route organises a first teaching draft of 15 ECTS. It preserves the
predecessor's equal animal/plant balance and different practical-credit weights.
It is not a room timetable or a statement of official assessment dates.

## A repeatable weekly rhythm

Begin with the biological question and a short prerequisite check. Read the
tutorial in sections, using the slides for discussion and the exercise for
application. Complete the practical activity alongside the relevant mechanism,
then revisit the quiz after a delay. Reserve time for reading, observation,
writing and feedback rather than treating every topic as another lecture.

| Week | Main route | Practical or discussion | Evidence of learning to keep |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | [A1: organisation](animal/organisation/index.qmd); begin [A2](animal/energy-temperature/index.qmd) | [Tissue and anatomy preparation](practicals/anatomy-histology.qmd); distinguish cell/tissue/organ and observation/inference | Annotated structure–function explanation and comparison between two animals |
| 2 | [A2: energy and temperature](animal/energy-temperature/index.qmd) | [Animal measurements](practicals/animal-measurements.qmd); introduce neural/endocrine coordination as mechanisms recur | Checked rate calculation, individual observations and physiological explanation |
| 3 | [A3: gas exchange and circulation](animal/gas-circulation/index.qmd) | Compare respiratory/circulatory arrangements; return to normal tissue evidence | Labelled pathway and explanation connecting demand, transport and exchange |
| 4 | [A4: water and excretion](animal/water-excretion/index.qmd) | Explain transport and a comparative osmotic challenge; draft animal report | Water/solute balance explanation, report draft and a limitation |
| 5 | [A5: integration](animal/integration/index.qmd); revisit mechanisms introduced earlier | [Animal revision](revision.qmd#animal-half); thematic discussion and report feedback | Integrated neural/endocrine/muscle explanation and corrected exercise work |
| 6 | [P1: organisation](plant/organisation/index.qmd); begin [P2](plant/water-nutrition/index.qmd) | Plant tissue observations; [water-relations activity](practicals/plant-water.qmd) preparation | Root-to-leaf pathway and tissue–function explanations |
| 7 | [P2: water and nutrition](plant/water-nutrition/index.qmd) | [Water-relations activity](practicals/plant-water.qmd); discuss soil/root/leaf conditions | Checked water calculation, figure and explanation of competing processes |
| 8 | [P3: carbon and metabolism](plant/carbon-metabolism/index.qmd) | [Photosynthesis activity](practicals/photosynthesis.qmd); connect source/sink and respiration | Light-response interpretation distinguishing net exchange and gross assimilation |
| 9 | [P4: development](plant/development/index.qmd) | [Development/stress activity](practicals/development-stress.qmd); begin [literature/presentation work](practicals/literature-presentation.qmd) | Developmental mechanism, experimental-design critique and evidence table |
| 10 | [P5: stress and biotechnology](plant/stress-biotechnology/index.qmd); integrate both halves | Presentation/discussion; [plant revision and integration](revision.qmd#plant-half); finish reports | Evidence-based biotechnology argument and linked organismal explanation |

Where the actual course includes live growth experiments, arrange their setup
and observation windows before fixing the timetable. Supplied-data activities
can run immediately, but do not stand in for carrying out the approved experiment.

## During each half

Use the [report guidance](practicals/reporting.qmd) from the first practical.
Leave time for revision after feedback. Normal histology needs repeated image
and specimen recognition with the teacher's actual resources, not only a
single reading session. Comparative explanation should recur throughout the
animal block; developmental and molecular connections should recur throughout
the plant block.

## Review without adding methods

At the end of each half, attempt the corresponding revision tasks without the
solutions visible. Reopen the unit where your mechanism is weak. A labelled
diagram, a small calculation and a clear explanation usually reveal more
than repeatedly rereading a list of terms. There is no extra computing week.
